meta.title: Sorun.dev — Coworking technology audits
meta.description: Independent technology audits for coworking spaces. WiFi, access control, management platform, meeting rooms — assessed, prioritised, and explained in plain language.

hero.label: Coworking technology advisory
hero.headline: You run the space. We handle the tech.
hero.subheadline: We audit the technology that runs your space — from WiFi and access control to your management platform, integrations, and everything in between. One fixed price. One clear report. A prioritised plan for fixing it.
hero.cta_sub: No commitment. No sales pitch. Just a conversation about your space.

problem.label: The problem
problem.body_1: Recurring WiFi complaints lead to churn. Broken access control wastes your staff's time. Manual processes that should be automated eat hours every week. Most coworking spaces are running on technology decisions that made sense at setup but no longer fit how the space actually operates — and by the time it breaks, it has already cost you members, revenue, and reputation.
problem.body_2: The help that exists does not fit. Enterprise integrators are too expensive. General IT support does not understand your operations. Software vendors only care about their own platform. You need someone who understands the full stack and the business it supports.

layers.label: What we audit
layers.headline: The 8 layers of workspace technology
layers.subheadline: Every coworking space runs on these eight systems. We assess all of them.

network.name: Network infrastructure
network.description: WiFi access points, switches, cabling, ISP, and network segmentation

access.name: Access control
access.description: Door hardware, fobs, mobile access, controllers, and intercom

platform.name: Space management platform
platform.description: Memberships, billing, bookings, member app, and reporting

meeting.name: Meeting room systems
meeting.description: AV equipment, displays, booking panels, and videoconferencing

security.name: Security & CCTV
security.description: Cameras, recording, retention, monitoring, and access to footage

telephony.name: Telephony & front of house
telephony.description: VoIP, intercom, reception hardware, and PA systems

integrations.name: Integrations & automation
integrations.description: System connections, workflows, APIs, and manual handoffs

devices.name: IT & device management
devices.description: Staff devices, printers, member-facing tech, and IT support

process.label: The methodology
process.headline: From first call to final report in 2–3 weeks

intake.title: Intake call
intake.description: You describe your situation. We assess fit and scope.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: You share floor plans and photos. We map technology to operational impact.

inventory.title: Stack inventory
inventory.description: All 8 layers documented. Every component recorded with its known issues.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: Each layer is rated for severity, business impact, and effort to fix.

report.title: Report & presentation
report.description: Written report. Prioritised roadmap. Live walkthrough and Q&A.

deliverables.label: What you receive
deliverables.headline: A clear picture and a plan to fix it

report.title: Full written report
report.description: A detailed document covering all 8 layers of your technology infrastructure. Plain language. No jargon.

findings.title: Prioritised findings
findings.description: Every finding categorised: act now, high priority, 90-day plan, and future consideration.

roadmap.title: Implementation roadmap
roadmap.description: A sequenced plan showing what to fix first, what it will cost, and how long it will take.

deliverables.note: Every audit includes a live presentation walkthrough where we talk you through the findings and answer your questions.

pricing.label: Entry-point audit
pricing.subtitle: Fixed price for a single-location audit. No hourly billing, no surprises.
pricing.multisite_text: Running multiple locations? Shared infrastructure means shared scope, not multiplied cost.

who.label: Who we help
who.headline: We work with independent operators who don't have a dedicated IT department.
who.body: Whether you are opening your first space or managing several, our audit ensures your technology foundations are built for growth, not firefighting.

qualifiers.q1: Independent coworking or flex office operator
qualifiers.q2: Single-site or small multi-site — without enterprise IT resources
qualifiers.q3: Dealing with tech that wastes your time or frustrates your members
qualifiers.q4: Ready to fix it properly, once

who.closing: If this sounds like you, we should talk.

final_cta.headline: Get the tech right. The rest gets easier.

footer.tagline: Independent technology audits for coworking and flex office operators.
